title: Z value help empty / every value rejected when logged on in Vietnamese
symptom: VI logon: value help list empty and a typed value is rejected ('Giá trị … không tồn tại'), so a mandatory filter blocks the search. EN logon works.
rootCause: The value-help view reads DDCDS_CUSTOMER_DOMAIN_VALUE_T WHERE language = $session.system_language, but the domain fixed-value texts exist only in language E.

solutions.label: Translate the domain fixed values to VI
solutions.body: Maintain the texts in VI for every domain the value help uses.

solutions.label: Fall back to E in the view
solutions.body: When no text exists in the logon language, use the E text.

prevention: Check every Z value help in both VI and EN logon (skill fiori-ui-check runs both).
